correctness.rationale: A vertex of T_n=L(K_n) is an edge uv of K_n. Its induced degree for selected base edges H is deg_H(u)+deg_H(v)-2, so the dissociation condition forces all components to be isolated vertices, K2s, or P3s (a degree-2 vertex cannot meet another degree-2 vertex). Exactly maximal selections either cover [n] by K2/P3 or have one isolated base vertex and all remaining P3. Exponential labeled-block enumeration yields D EGF exp(x+zx^2/2+z^2x^3/2) and M EGF exp(zx^2/2+z^2x^3/2)+x exp(z^2x^3/2). The support of M is every degree ceil(n/2)..floor(2n/3) and singleton exactly n=2,3,4,5,7. Strict log-concavity follows from decreasing adjacent full-partition coefficient ratios; the n=3q+1 corrected last ratio remains smaller than its predecessor for q>=5, while q<=4 has at most two coefficients. Independently checked each graph subset at n2..6 by original adjacency/maximality definitions; examined supplied verifier for larger-n size-truncated enumeration and distinguished finite corroboration from proof.
